verdict.rationale: Entrust IDV supports background/asynchronous operation via webhooks that notify status changes and no-code Workflow Studio that lets workflows run without developer involvement, enabling verification pipelines to run autonomously once triggered via API. However, there's no evidence of AI-agent-specific automation, scheduling/triggers beyond webhook events, or any framing of 'autonomous' agentic behavior beyond standard async API/webhook patterns. Missing for 10: explicit AI/agent automation triggers, scheduled/recurring automation setup, and independent corroboration of autonomous operation beyond docs.
